text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks for gains, then bought Stock E again at a higher price; I should base buys and sells on the outlook and my plan, not on the comfort of a realized gain.","My account rose substantially while I mostly held, so I should not assume frequent trading will improve my results.","A one-month decline after a strong rise is not by itself a reason to act; I should review my portfolio calmly and avoid reacting to short-term changes."]}
